name: AutoLife Robotics
summary: AutoLife Robotics develops humanoid robots for retail, reception, dining and other indoor service work. The brand began in Singapore in 2023 and operates in China through Guangdong AutoLife Technology, with offices in Guangzhou and Shenzhen. Its work combines robot hardware, navigation, perception and manipulation with application design, field deployment and support.
